title: Octopus Facts That Sound Fake
hook: An octopus has three hearts, and that's not even the weirdest part.

beats.narration: An octopus has three hearts, and that's not even the weirdest part.
Two hearts pump blood to the gills. The third pumps it to the rest of the body.
Their blood is blue, because it uses copper instead of iron to carry oxygen.
About two thirds of their neurons sit in their arms, so each arm can taste and react on its own.
And the weirdest part? When an octopus swims, the heart that feeds its body actually stops beating.
That's why they'd rather crawl. Which octopus fact surprised you most?

cta_question: Which octopus fact surprised you most?
description_body: Octopus facts that sound fake but are true: three hearts, blue copper-based blood, and arms packed with neurons.
pinned_comment: Three hearts or thinking arms: which is the more impressive superpower? 🐙
